title: G4-QuadScreen: A Computational Tool for Identifying Multi-Target-Directed Anticancer Leads against G-Quadruplex DNA.
summary: Screened compounds underwent G4 stabilization and cell-viability assays. The result is preclinical lead activity; a tool release alone is not the admission basis.
organization: Universitat de València; Universitat de Barcelona; Consorci Institut D'Investigacions Biomediques August Pi I Sunyer

evidence.tested: Screened compounds underwent G4 stabilization and cell-viability assays. The result is preclinical lead activity; a tool release alone is not the admission basis.
evidence.unknown: The date refers to the cited version. Earlier public versions and independent replication were not systematically verified.
evidence.ai_role: Random-forest and linear-discriminant multitasking QSAR is the AI method documented in the editorial source review.
